October 02, 2026 Federal Reserve Board issues enforcement action with Ontario Bancorporation, Inc. For release at 11:00 a.m. EDT Share --> --> --> --> --> --> The Federal Reserve Board on Friday announced the execution of the following enforcement action listed below: Ontario Bancorporation, Inc., Ontario, Wisconsin Written Agreement dated September 24, 2026 Additional enforcement actions can be searched for here . For media inquiries, please email [email protected] or call 202-452-2955. Attachment (PDF) Last Update: October 02, 2026

reason: Ontario Bancorporation enforcement action raises arguable questions about whether Fed's regulatory approach deters misconduct or drives compliance theater without addressing root causes.
angle: Federal enforcement actions against small regional banks may signal effective regulation or symbolic action that misses systemic vulnerabilities.
